verdict.rationale: Parse returns structured JSON with typed elements (text, tables, figures, layout, formatting), each tagged with type and page position, and handles multi-column layouts. Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries such as section headers, and output is positioned as LLM-ready JSON or Markdown, so downstream models receive structure rather than flat text. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reading-order guarantees and nested heading/section hierarchy in the output schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration of structure preservation.
